schema.description: Three sections for inserted answer elements, main visuals and supporting materials. Markdown text and native Markdown tables remain owned by AnswerMarkdown.
schema.selection_rule: State and keywords rank eligible content; they cannot create data, change scientific context or enable a hidden component.
schema.agent_input: result.result_page_keywords or run.evidence.result_page_keywords: an array of exact registered tokens, separate from answer Markdown
schema.kg_input: Returned graph nodes/edges, recorded functional measurements, answer-profile rule IDs, and validated resource manifests
schema.unknown_keyword: Ignore and record in selector decisions; never scan free-form answer text for component names.
schema.follow_up: The existing Follow Up controls remain outside this schema.

ai_summary.title: AI Overview
ai_summary.description: The agent writes the answer in Markdown. This section defines only extra elements inserted alongside that text.

raw_data_download.title: Source data
raw_data_download.description: Download the available source data or explicitly labeled metadata used in this answer.
raw_data_download.format: A compact box with one labeled download link per available data asset.
raw_data_download.data_binding: result.resources.assets, joined to resource_groups by asset ID or URL

donor_index.label: Download donor/sample metadata
donor_index.content: Retrieved metadata index; not sequencing files

raw_data_download.wording: Preserve source, credible-set and cohort labels. A plot image is not raw data. Cohort means are not original donor-level traces.

main_visuals.title: Visual Material
main_visuals.format: Existing main visual panel with one tab per eligible view.

graph_viewer.title: Knowledge Graph
graph_viewer.kg_rule: Select when a graph projection exists or the recorded graph query is pending, empty or failed; retain its actual status.
graph_viewer.format: Keep existing network/list modes, zoom, legend, full-screen and evidence inspection.
graph_viewer.wording: Separate displayed counts from retrieved counts and retrieval completeness.

single_cell_browser.title: scBrowser
single_cell_browser.kg_rule: Activate only for a returned supported RNA expression edge with a valid gene. ATAC activity is not RNA expression.

selection.description: Use the first eligible gene-cell pair as the initial gene and cell highlight; do not reshuffle on rerender.

wording.no_resource: No single-cell browser resource is available for this result.
wording.start_failed: The cell browser could not start. Reload this result or open PanKbase.

single_cell_browser.format: A map-only graph-adjacent preview opens the persistent interactive scBrowser tab. Preserve graph controls and camera.
single_cell_browser.source_identity: Display labels are editable copy; datasetId, source hashes, recorded edge release and conditions remain technical provenance, unchanged by wording edits.

qtl_fine_mapping.title: QTL Fine-Mapping

wording.title: Regional Fine-Mapping Plot
wording.failed: The production plot could not be loaded. The source data remains available below.
wording.unsupported_source: This QTL source does not have a registered production plot.
wording.missing_credible_set: A valid credible-set identifier is required to load this source's plot.
wording.gene_mismatch: The recorded credible set does not match the gene on this QTL edge.
wording.no_context: No QTL context is available for this result.
wording.description:
This plot integrates multiple fine-mapping statistics (−log₁₀P, PIP, LBF) across a genomic region. The three-row scatter view condenses QTL evidence.
Row 1 shows −log₁₀ P for classical association strength.
Row 2 reports the posterior inclusion probability (PIP) from Bayesian fine-mapping.
Row 3 displays the log Bayes factor (LBF) for complementary Bayes support.
Point colour encodes LD R² relative to the lead SNP (red dashed line), allowing you to gauge how neighbouring variants track the core signal.
Together these layers highlight candidate causal variants and their statistical weight at a glance.
wording.provenance: Uses the existing production AWS renderer for the recorded source and credible set. Track values, LD colors and lead markers are supplied by that renderer; this page does not calculate them.

qtl_fine_mapping.source_identity: Use exact returned source and credible set; do not substitute a gene, source, LD panel or coordinate plot.

functional_data.title: Functional Data
functional_data.kg_rule: A functional intent must match recorded functional filters/measurements or the backend functional result type. An assay name on a KG node alone is insufficient.
functional_data.format: Existing cohort-response plot with expand/download controls and an explicit pending or unavailable state.
functional_data.wording: Keep selected cohort, hormone, units, normalization and aggregation. Do not infer donor variability from a cohort mean.

genome_browser.title: Genome Browser
genome_browser.format: Existing embedded genome-browser component, reserved for later activation.
genome_browser.wording: Remain hidden. The current demo has a disabled IGV adapter; state parameters and agent keywords cannot enable it.

supporting_materials.title: Supporting Material
supporting_materials.format: Keep existing reference cards, resource links and empirical-evidence panels.

references.title: References
references.format: Reference cards with title, available authors/journal/year, PMID or DOI and source link.
references.wording: Preserve reference identity and source type. A background reference is not automatically evidence supporting the conclusion.

links.title: Links
links.data_binding: Backend-approved resources_tabs.pankbase_links and resources_tabs.external_link_groups (legacy external_links supported)
links.kg_rule: Use only links returned by the backend resource registry for actual entity/relation context; never invent URLs from keywords.

external_links.title: External Links
external_links.format: Collapsed source cards with unique-link counts and up to three node previews. Expand to linked node names and identifiers; show ten entries before Show all. Search above ten total links. Structured external_link_groups contain source_key, display_name, entries[{url,label,entities[{id,name,types}],provenance}]; legacy [title,description,URL] entries are grouped with exact saved-evidence URL matching.

links.wording: Label dataset, method, code, portal or entity record. A navigation link does not establish a measured finding.

empirical_evidence.title: Empirical Evidence
empirical_evidence.format: Source-scoped plot, description and download links; retain independent source groups.
empirical_evidence.wording: Describe actual rendered measurements, source and context. Do not assume LD colors or tracks exist. Metadata-only indexes retain their metadata label.
empirical_evidence.deduplication: Do not repeat the main functional plot asset here; preserve independent empirical sources and their availability states.
